rejected_rule.statement: A bank that pays a cheque under the mistaken belief that it is genuine and which induces another party to pay out the proceeds in good faith cannot recover those funds from the recipient.
rejected_rule.supporting_quote: The money paid under a mistake was received in good faith and in good faith paid out to John Perera. It would not have been so applied had not the bank represented that it considered the cheques to bear the genuine signature of its customer.
